# Control CheckBox
Part of the control family FluentV9.
Do not use CheckBox unless it's already present in this app. Use the updated ModernCheckbox instead for any new instances in this app.

Control creation keywords:
```yaml
Control: CheckBox
```

Containment:
- Declared nesting: supports=False, replicates=False
- YAML children supported: False; Canvas Component descendants supported: False
Omitted restrictions do not imply unrestricted composition; flags, variants and compilation still apply. Mapped identities may be structural, not independently creatable controls.

Input Properties:
  - AccessibleLabel: Text
      Default: ""
  - BasePaletteColor: Color
  - CheckboxSize: Number
      Default: 16
  - Checked: Boolean
      Default: false
  - ContentLanguage: Text
      Default: ""
  - DisplayMode: Enum
      Default: DisplayMode.Edit
      Enum name: DisplayMode
      Enum values: Disabled, Edit, View
  - Font: Enum
      Default: ""
      Enum name: Font
      Enum values: Arial, Courier New, Dancing Script, Georgia, Great Vibes, Lato, Lato Black, Lato Hairline, Lato Light, Open Sans, Open Sans Condensed, Patrick Hand, Segoe UI, Verdana
  - FontColor: Color
  - FontItalic: Boolean
      Default: false
  - FontSize: Number
      Default: 0
  - FontStrikethrough: Boolean
      Default: false
  - FontUnderline: Boolean
      Default: false
  - FontWeight: Enum
      Default: ""
      Enum name: FontWeight
      Enum values: Bold, Lighter, Normal, Semibold
  - Height: Number
      Default: 32
  - Label: Text
      Default: "Checkbox"
  - OnCheck: Boolean
      Default: false
  - OnSelect: Boolean
      Default: false
  - OnUncheck: Boolean
      Default: false
  - Visible: Boolean
      Default: true
  - Width: Number
      Default: 160
  - X: Number
      Default: 0
  - Y: Number
      Default: 0

Additional input properties if a child of a Vertical or Horizontal GroupContainer:
  - AlignInContainer: Enum
      Default: AlignInContainer.SetByContainer
      Enum name: AlignInContainer
      Enum values: Center, End, SetByContainer, Start, Stretch
  - FillPortions: Number
      Default: 0
  - LayoutMaxHeight: Number
      Default: 0
  - LayoutMaxWidth: Number
      Default: 0
  - LayoutMinHeight: Number
      Default: 32
  - LayoutMinWidth: Number
      Default: 160

Additional input properties if a child of a Grid GroupContainer:
  - LayoutGridColumnEnd: Number
  - LayoutGridColumnStart: Number
  - LayoutGridRowEnd: Number
  - LayoutGridRowStart: Number

Output Properties:
  - Checked: Boolean - Whether the checkbox is checked.
  - ContentLanguage: Text - The language of the control's content, if different from the control's container.
  - DisplayMode: Enum - Visual and interaction state of the control.
  - Height: Number - Height of the visual.
  - Visible: Boolean - Show or hide the visual.
  - Width: Number - Width of the visual.
  - X: Number - Horizontal position of the visual.
  - Y: Number - Vertical position of the value.
